fullPassage: The introduction of scientific methods into medical practice transformed the profession as well as its object. Until the late nineteenth century, doctors were not required to have studied medicine and were relied on mainly to provide comfort and guidance to their patients. As the practice of medicine shifted from cure to prevention, doctors were now expected to provide results based on scientific evidence. As a result of this access to forms of knowledge beyond the understanding of the general public, more authority and power was granted to the medical profession, and the nature of the doctor/patient relationship changed. Once the source of a disease was identified, patients expected that doctors should be able to cure them. Additionally, those doctors with scientific training were now distinguished from a range of alternative healers, from homeopaths to midwives, resulting in an elevation in the eyes of the public of the status of the profession as compared with other healing practices, which persists today.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: result(동사) → resulting(현재분사). 앞 문장 전체를 부연하는 분사구문. '~, 그 결과 ...를 초래하면서'로 해석. 콤마 뒤 분사가 앞 절의 결과를 나타냄
det.tip: 분사구문 resulting in=그 결과 ~을 초래하며. 능동 의미라 현재분사(-ing)

questions.passage: The introduction of scientific methods into medical practice transformed the profession as well as its object. Until the late nineteenth century, doctors were not required to have studied medicine and were relied on mainly to provide __________ to their patients. As the practice of medicine shifted from cure to prevention, doctors were now expected to provide results based on scientific evidence. As a result of this access to forms of knowledge beyond the understanding of the general public, more authority and power was granted to the medical profession, and the nature of the doctor/patient relationship changed. Once the source of a disease was identified, patients expected that doctors should be able to cure them. Additionally, those doctors with scientific training were now distinguished from a range of alternative healers, from homeopaths to midwives, resulting in an elevation in the eyes of the public of the status of the profession as compared with other healing practices, which persists today.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 의사들은 주로 환자에게 ______을 제공하기 위해 의존되었다 (위안과 지도)
det.analysis:
✅ ① comfort and guidance(위안과 지도): 19세기 이전 의사의 역할 ← 정답
❌ ② profit and loss(이익과 손실): 회계 표현, 문맥 무관
❌ ③ fame and fortune(명성과 부): 문맥 무관
❌ ④ risk and reward(위험과 보상): 문맥 무관
det.tip: provide comfort and guidance=위안과 지도를 제공하다. 과학 이전 의사의 역할

questions.passage: The introduction of scientific methods into medical practice transformed the profession as well as its object. Until the late nineteenth century, doctors were not required to have studied medicine and were relied on mainly to provide comfort and guidance to their patients. As the practice of medicine shifted from cure to prevention, doctors were now expected to provide results __________. As a result of this access to forms of knowledge beyond the understanding of the general public, more authority and power was granted to the medical profession, and the nature of the doctor/patient relationship changed. Once the source of a disease was identified, patients expected that doctors should be able to cure them. Additionally, those doctors with scientific training were now distinguished from a range of alternative healers, from homeopaths to midwives, resulting in an elevation in the eyes of the public of the status of the profession as compared with other healing practices, which persists today.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 의사들은 이제 ______ 결과를 제공하도록 기대되었다 (과학적 증거에 기반한)
det.analysis:
❌ ① without any explanation(아무 설명 없이): 과학화 흐름과 반대
❌ ② in exchange for money(돈을 대가로): 문맥 무관
✅ ③ based on scientific evidence(과학적 증거에 기반한): 예방·과학화 흐름의 핵심 ← 정답
❌ ④ regardless of any proof(어떤 증거와도 무관하게): 과학적 증거와 정반대
det.tip: results based on scientific evidence=과학적 증거에 기반한 결과. 의학의 과학화
